response.overview: A Bristol-based puppet musical featuring a gang of misfit puppets Barry the Baker, Jerry the Janitor, Kerry the Kicker and Bev the Builder.  When four washed up puppets lose their jobs, their leader Barry, dreaming of Hollywood fame, convinces them to kidnap a famous Hollywood movie director and force him to watch their big musical audition, hoping it’s their shot at stardom. What follows is a daring heist, a street musical number and one gang hoping to make it to Hollywood.
response.tagline: Watch out Hollywood. There’s new puppets in town.
response.title: The Grand Puppet Heist
